name: Job Posting to Spreadsheet Transfer
goal: Extract job details from a job posting page and append them as a new row to a spreadsheet.

variables.name: company_name
variables.description: The name of the company offering the job, extracted from the job posting content.

variables.name: role_title
variables.description: The specific job title or role being offered, extracted from the job posting content.

variables.name: location
variables.description: The geographical location associated with the job posting.

variables.name: salary
variables.description: The salary offered for the position, which may be optional.

variables.name: url
variables.description: The direct URL of the job posting page.
